verdicts.reason: Both reorder the copy to '$199 / New York / from', which breaks the original 'New York from $199' message. Both also shrink the headline, the tiny 'from' and the Book CTA to near-insignificance and drop the logo to the bottom-left so it no longer leads. A is worse: its whole column sits off-centre to the right (axis about x=240 on a 432 canvas), leaving a lopsided empty left side and a large dead band at the top. B at least centres the column, though its logo crowds the bottom-left edge and the oversized suitcase still outweighs the text.
